memory_update.text: VECO should be tracked as a US-listed underfollowed compound-semiconductor equipment candidate for photonics/laser epitaxy capacity expansion; evidence still needs to isolate AI optical demand from broader semi-cap cycles.

AXTI is a high-relevance underfollowed InP/GaAs substrate candidate; key survival test is whether InP demand from AI optical transceivers becomes material enough to overcome legacy cyclicality and China/Tongmei complexity.
Tower Semiconductor maps to the silicon-photonics foundry-capacity branch of the node and should be evaluated separately from InP substrate and laser-device suppliers.

Layer 1B still needs a focused check for additional US-listed niche suppliers in optical testing, burn-in, wafer inspection, gas/precursor supply, and precision assembly equipment tied specifically to InP/GaAs photonics.

node: Optical connectivity, lasers, compound-semiconductor epitaxy, and epitaxy equipment
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the upstream optical-connectivity bottleneck. The cleanest underfollowed lane is not transceiver assembly itself, but InP/GaAs substrates, MOCVD/MBE/compound-semiconductor process tools, silicon-photonics foundry capacity, and direct InP laser suppliers. This pass keeps one reference laser name for context and prioritizes small/mid-cap or lower-mindshare public companies where the AI link is one or two steps removed from the headline demand driver.
